subject.title: Feature request: Local plugin scanner CLI for pre-publish validation

question: Should local pre-publish plugin validation guarantee full hosted ClawScan parity or expose a stable deterministic subset?
rationale: Current main contains both partial public validation and fuller internal scanning, but deciding which checks, model calls, secrets, redaction rules, severities, and compatibility guarantees become public requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Stable deterministic subset
options.body: Expose shared manifest, metadata, schema, and static-risk checks locally while documenting model-backed hosted findings as supplemental.

options.title: Full hosted parity
options.body: Expose model-backed scanning locally and support its credential, privacy, cost, redaction, and versioning obligations.

options.title: Keep scanning internal
options.body: Retain repository-only scanning and improve upload-time diagnostics without adding a supported local scanner.

recommendation.title: Stable deterministic subset
recommendation.body: Expose shared manifest, metadata, schema, and static-risk checks locally while documenting model-backed hosted findings as supplemental.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and recently maintained the closest local scanner and public validation implementations.
